spans.s:
cl. 6. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxviii, 71; 135; but cf. Vām. v, 2, 2) मिलति, ˚ते (pf. मिमिलुः, Kāv.; fut. मिलिष्यति, Br.; aor. अमेलीत्, अमेलिष्ट Gr.; ind.p. मिलित्वा and -मिल्य, Kathās. &c.),
to meet (as friends or foes), encounter, join, fall in with (instr. with or without सह; dat. gen., or loc.), come together, assemble, concur, Kāv.; Kathās.; Rājat. &c.:
Caus. मेलयति (or मेलापयति; cf. मेलापक),
to cause any one to meet any one else (gen.), bring together, assemble, Kathās.

cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xv, 10) मीलति (rarely Ā. ˚ते; pf. मिमील, Kāv.; aor. अमीलीत् Gr.; fut. मीलिता, मीलिष्यति, ib.; ind.p. -मील्य, RV.),
to close the eyes, Gīt.;
to close (intrans., said of the eyes), wink, twinkle, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.;
 (= मिल्) to assemble, be collected, Uttarar. :
Caus. मीलयति (ep. also ˚ते; aor. अमिमीलत्, or अमीमिलत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 3),
to cause to close, close (eyes, blossoms &c.), Kāv.; Pur. :
Desid. मिमीलिषति Gr.:
Intens. मेमील्यते, मेमील्ति, ib.
meeting, joining &c.
appearing, happening, occurring, Naiṣ.
(ibc. or ifc.) joined or connected with, Kāv.; Pañcar.
joined or surrounded by huntsmen, Kathās.
coming together, meeting, contact, union, Amar.; Gīt.
the act of closing the eyes, Kathās.
closing (intrans., said of eyes and flowers), Kir., Sch.; Sāh.
(in rhet.) a covert or concealed simile (cf. मीलित), Pratāp.
See दुर्-म्˚.
N. of a woman, Rājat.
See दुर्-म्˚.
See नील-म्˚
black brass, L. (v.l. निलिका).
met, encountered, united &c.
happened, occurred, Kāv.
(ifc.) connected or combined or mixed or furnished with, Pañcat.
one who has closed his eyes, sleepy (only compar. ˚त॑-तर), ŚBr.
closed, obstructed (opp. to मुक्त), PañcavBr.
closed, unblown, partly opened (as eyes, blossoms &c.), Kāv.; Pur.
disappeared, ceased to be, BhP.
met, assembled, gathered together, Rājat.

(in. rhet.) an implied simile (in which the similarity between two objects is only implied, as in the example: ‘women clothed in white are invisible in the moonlight, therefore they are as bright as moonlight’), Kpr.; Kuval.
a bee, Bhām.
N. of a king (= Menander), Buddh.
मिलिन्द—प्रश्न m. N. of a Pāli wk. (containing a conversation on Nirvāṇa between king Milinda and the monk Nāga-sena),
MWB. 141
a kind of snake, Suśr.
N. of Śiva, MBh. (accord. to Sch. fr. a Mantra containing the word मिलि repeated twice).
